<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<meta name="description" content="Brilliant Quartz II — Financial guidance with purpose. Connect with Raymond John Bonus, Financial Advisor.">
<title>Brilliant Quartz II | Financial Advisor</title>
<style>
:root {
  --navy:#071a35; --navy2:#0d274b; --gold:#d9a93a; --gold2:#f4d37b;
  --cream:#f8f5ed; --white:#fff; --ink:#15243a; --muted:#66758a;
  --line:rgba(217,169,58,.25); --shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(4,18,38,.16);
}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{font-family:Inter,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,-apple-system,Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;color:var(--ink);background:#fff;line-height:1.6}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
.container{width:min(1160px,92%);margin:auto}
.nav{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:20;background:rgba(7,26,53,.96);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.nav-inner{height:76px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:25px}
.logo{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;color:#fff;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.02em}
.logo-mark{width:42px;height:42px;border:2px solid var(--gold);display:grid;place-items:center;transform:rotate(45deg);border-radius:6px}
.logo-mark span{transform:rotate(-45deg);font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:20px;color:var(--gold)}
.logo-text small{display:block;color:var(--gold2);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.23em}
.logo-text strong{display:block;font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:19px}
.nav-links{display:flex;gap:26px;color:#e8edf5;font-size:14px;font-weight:600}
.nav-links a:hover{color:var(--gold2)}
.nav-cta{padding:11px 18px;border:1px solid var(--gold);border-radius:999px;color:#fff;font-size:13px;font-weight:700}
.hero{background:radial-gradient(circle at 78% 20%,#183e70 0,#0b2548 34%,#071a35 72%);color:#fff;overflow:hidden}
.hero-grid{min-height:690px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.03fr .97fr;align-items:center;gap:45px;padding:72px 0}
.kicker{color:var(--gold2);font-size:13px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:18px}
h1{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-weight:500;font-size:clamp(44px,6vw,76px);line-height:1.02;margin-bottom:22px}
h1 em{color:var(--gold2);font-style:normal}
.hero p{font-size:18px;color:#d8e2ef;max-width:610px;margin-bottom:30px}
.btns{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:13px}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:14px 22px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:800;font-size:14px}
.btn-gold{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--gold2),var(--gold));color:#081a32;box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(217,169,58,.25)}
.btn-outline{border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.3);color:#fff}
.hero-card{position:relative;max-width:520px;margin:auto}
.hero-card::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-20px -15px 20px 25px;border:1px solid var(--gold);border-radius:28px;transform:rotate(3deg);opacity:.45}
.portrait{position:relative;width:100%;height:610px;object-fit:cover;object-position:center top;border-radius:26px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);background:#eee}
.hero-badge{position:absolute;left:-25px;bottom:28px;background:#fff;color:var(--navy);padding:18px 22px;border-radius:16px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);max-width:250px}
.hero-badge b{display:block;font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:18px}
.hero-badge span{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}
.section{padding:90px 0}
.section.alt{background:var(--cream)}
.section-head{max-width:760px;margin:0 auto 45px;text-align:center}
.section-head .kicker{color:#9b711c}
h2{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:clamp(32px,4vw,52px);line-height:1.1;color:var(--navy);margin-bottom:15px}
.section-head p{color:var(--muted);font-size:17px}
.cards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:20px}
.card{padding:30px;border:1px solid #e4e8ee;border-radius:20px;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 10px 35px rgba(7,26,53,.06)}
.card .icon{width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid var(--gold);display:grid;place-items:center;color:#9b711c;font-weight:900;margin-bottom:20px}
.card h3{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:23px;color:var(--navy);margin-bottom:9px}
.card p{color:var(--muted);font-size:15px}
.about{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.9fr 1.1fr;gap:70px;align-items:center}
.about-box{background:var(--navy);color:#fff;padding:38px;border-radius:25px;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.about-box .quote{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:30px;line-height:1.25;color:var(--gold2);margin-bottom:20px}
.about-copy p{color:var(--muted);font-size:16px;margin:0 0 18px}
.steps{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:12px}
.step{padding:22px 16px;border-top:3px solid var(--gold);background:#fff;border-radius:0 0 14px 14px}
.step strong{display:block;color:var(--gold);font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.08em;margin-bottom:7px}
.step h3{font-size:17px;color:var(--navy);margin-bottom:7px}
.step p{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}
.recruit{background:linear-gradient(120deg,#071a35,#10345d);color:#fff;border-radius:30px;padding:65px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr .8fr;gap:40px;align-items:center}
.recruit h2{color:#fff}
.recruit p{color:#d9e4f2;max-width:670px}
.pills{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;margin:25px 0}
.pill{border:1px solid rgba(244,211,123,.4);padding:9px 13px;border-radius:999px;color:#f6e4ac;font-size:13px}
.contact{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.9fr 1.1fr;gap:40px}
.contact-panel{background:var(--navy);color:#fff;border-radius:25px;padding:38px}
.contact-panel h3{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:30px;color:var(--gold2);margin-bottom:12px}
.contact-panel p{color:#d9e4f2;margin-bottom:22px}
.contact-line{padding:12px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);font-size:14px}
.form{padding:35px;border:1px solid #e2e7ed;border-radius:25px}
.form label{display:block;font-size:13px;font-weight:800;color:var(--navy);margin:0 0 7px}
.form input,.form textarea{width:100%;padding:13px 14px;border:1px solid #d7dde5;border-radius:10px;margin-bottom:18px;font:inherit}
.form textarea{min-height:130px;resize:vertical}
.footer{background:#041226;color:#c9d5e3;padding:35px 0}
.footer-inner{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;align-items:center}
.footer small{color:#8fa0b6}
.disclaimer{font-size:11px;color:#8392a6;margin-top:18px;max-width:900px}
@media(max-width:900px){
 .nav-links{display:none} .hero-grid,.about,.contact,.recruit{grid-template-columns:1fr}
 .hero-grid{padding:55px 0} .portrait{height:520px} .hero-badge{left:15px}
 .cards{grid-template-columns:1fr} .steps{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr} .recruit{padding:38px}
}
@media(max-width:560px){
 .nav-inner{height:68px} .logo-text strong{font-size:16px} .nav-cta{display:none}
 h1{font-size:45px} .section{padding:65px 0} .steps{grid-template-columns:1fr}
 .portrait{height:470px} .footer-inner{flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start}
}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<header class="nav">
  <div class="container nav-inner">
    <a class="logo" href="#home" aria-label="Brilliant Quartz II home">
      <div class="logo-mark"><span>BQ</span></div>
      <div class="logo-text"><strong>Brilliant Quartz II</strong><small>FINANCIAL ADVISOR</small></div>
    </a>
    <nav class="nav-links">
      <a href="#about">About</a><a href="#planning">Planning</a><a href="#approach">Approach</a><a href="#career">Career</a><a href="#contact">Contact</a>
    </nav>
    <a class="nav-cta" href="#contact">Let's Talk</a>
  </div>
</header>

<main id="home">
<section class="hero">
  <div class="container hero-grid">
    <div>
      <div class="kicker">Brilliant Quartz II</div>
      <h1>Plan wisely.<br><em>Live confidently.</em></h1>
      <p>Financial guidance designed around your goals, your priorities, and the life you want to build—one thoughtful decision at a time.</p>
      <div class="btns">
        <a class="btn btn-gold" href="#contact">Start a Conversation</a>
        <a class="btn btn-outline" href="#planning">Explore Financial Planning</a>
      </div>
      <p style="font-size:13px;margin-top:24px;color:#9fb0c6">PLAN WISELY. • GROW STEADILY. • LIVE FREELY.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="hero-card">
      <img class="portrait" src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Raymond John Bonus, Financial Advisor">
      <div class="hero-badge"><b>Raymond John Bonus</b><span>Financial Advisor • Brilliant Quartz II</span></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="section" id="planning">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="section-head">
      <div class="kicker">Financial Planning</div>
      <h2>Your money should have a purpose.</h2>
      <p>Good planning starts with understanding what matters most to you, then building a strategy around those priorities.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="cards">
      <article class="card"><div class="icon">01</div><h3>Financial Protection</h3><p>Prepare for uncertainties and help protect the people, income, and goals that matter most.</p></article>
      <article class="card"><div class="icon">02</div><h3>Wealth Building</h3><p>Turn long-term goals into a practical roadmap for growing and managing your financial resources.</p></article>
      <article class="card"><div class="icon">03</div><h3>Legacy Planning</h3><p>Think beyond today and prepare intentionally for the people and causes you want to support.</p></article>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="section alt" id="about">
  <div class="container about">
    <div class="about-box">
      <div class="quote">“The goal isn't simply to have more. It's to have a plan for what matters.”</div>
      <div style="color:#c9d5e3">Raymond John Bonus<br><strong style="color:#fff">Financial Advisor</strong></div>
    </div>
    <div class="about-copy">
      <div class="kicker">About Raymond</div>
      <h2>Advice that starts with listening.</h2>
      <p>Every financial situation is different. A meaningful planning conversation begins by understanding your current position, your responsibilities, and the goals you want to pursue.</p>
      <p>Raymond's role is to help clients organize those priorities, explore appropriate financial strategies, and make informed decisions with greater clarity.</p>
      <p><strong style="color:var(--navy)">No one-size-fits-all promises. Just a thoughtful process built around your goals.</strong></p>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="section" id="approach">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="section-head">
      <div class="kicker">The Process</div>
      <h2>A clearer path starts here.</h2>
      <p>Financial planning doesn't need to feel overwhelming. We can break it down into manageable conversations.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="steps">
      <div class="step"><strong>01</strong><h3>Understand</h3><p>Clarify your goals and priorities.</p></div>
      <div class="step"><strong>02</strong><h3>Review</h3><p>Look at your current financial picture.</p></div>
      <div class="step"><strong>03</strong><h3>Prioritize</h3><p>Identify what deserves attention first.</p></div>
      <div class="step"><strong>04</strong><h3>Plan</h3><p>Explore strategies suited to your needs.</p></div>
      <div class="step"><strong>05</strong><h3>Review</h3><p>Adjust your plan as life changes.</p></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="section alt" id="career">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="recruit">
      <div>
        <div class="kicker">Career Opportunity</div>
        <h2>Build a career with purpose.</h2>
        <p>Brilliant Quartz II is also growing a community of people who want to develop professionally while helping families make better-informed financial decisions.</p>
        <div class="pills"><span class="pill">Training & Mentorship</span><span class="pill">Professional Growth</span><span class="pill">Flexible Career Path</span><span class="pill">Purpose-Driven Work</span></div>
        <a class="btn btn-gold" href="#contact">Explore the Opportunity</a>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align:center">
        <div style="font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:74px;color:var(--gold2)">∞</div>
        <p style="font-size:20px"><strong>Your potential is bigger than one job title.</strong></p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="section" id="contact">
  <div class="container contact">
    <div class="contact-panel">
      <div class="kicker">Let's Connect</div>
      <h3>Start with a conversation.</h3>
      <p>Whether you're exploring financial planning or a career in financial advising, let's talk about where you want to go.</p>
      <div class="contact-line"><strong>Raymond John Bonus</strong><br>Financial Advisor • Brilliant Quartz II</div>
      <div class="contact-line">Email: <span style="color:#f4d37b">YOUR-EMAIL@EXAMPLE.COM</span></div>
      <div class="contact-line">Phone: <span style="color:#f4d37b">YOUR PHONE NUMBER</span></div>
      <div class="contact-line">Facebook / Instagram / LinkedIn: <span style="color:#f4d37b">Add your links</span></div>
    </div>
    <form class="form" onsubmit="event.preventDefault(); alert('Thank you! Please connect this form to your preferred email/form service before publishing.');">
      <h3 style="font-family:Georgia,serif;color:var(--navy);font-size:28px;margin-bottom:18px">Send an inquiry</h3>
      <label for="name">Name</label><input id="name" required placeholder="Your name">
      <label for="email">Email</label><input id="email" type="email" required placeholder="you@example.com">
      <label for="interest">I'm interested in</label><input id="interest" placeholder="Financial planning or career opportunity">
      <label for="message">Message</label><textarea id="message" required placeholder="Tell Raymond what you'd like to discuss."></textarea>
      <button class="btn btn-gold" type="submit" style="border:0;cursor:pointer;width:100%">Send Message</button>
    </form>
  </div>
</section>
</main>

<footer class="footer">
  <div class="container footer-inner">
    <div><strong style="color:#fff;font-family:Georgia,serif">Brilliant Quartz II</strong><br><small>PLAN WISELY. • GROW STEADILY. • LIVE FREELY.</small></div>
    <small>© 2026 Brilliant Quartz II. All rights reserved.</small>
  </div>
  <div class="container disclaimer">Important: This starter website uses general educational language. Replace placeholder contact details and review all service, licensing, regulatory, and product-specific claims with the appropriate compliance requirements before publishing.</div>
</footer>

</body>
</html><!doctype html>

<header class="nav">
  <div class="container nav-inner">
    <a class="logo" href="#home" aria-label="Brilliant Quartz II home">

<header class="nav">
  <div class="container nav-inner">
    <a class="logo" href="#home" aria-label="Brilliant Quartz II home">
      <div class="logo-mark"><span>BQ</span></div>
      <div class="logo-text"><strong>Brilliant Quartz II</strong><small>FINANCIAL ADVISOR</small></div>
    </a>
    <nav class="nav-links">
      <a href="#about">About</a><a href="#planning">Planning</a><a href="#approach">Approach</a><a href="#career">Career</a><a href="#contact">Contact</a>
    </nav>
    <a class="nav-cta" href="#contact">Let's Talk</a>
  </div>
</header>

<main id="home">
<section class="hero">
  <div class="container hero-grid">
    <div>
      <div class="kicker">Brilliant Quartz II</div>
      <h1>Plan wisely.<br><em>Live confidently.</em></h1>
      <p>Financial guidance designed around your goals, your priorities, and the life you want to build—one thoughtful decision at a time.</p>
      <div class="btns">
        <a class="btn btn-gold" href="#contact">Start a Conversation</a>
        <a class="btn btn-outline" href="#planning">Explore Financial Planning</a>
      </div>
      <p style="font-size:13px;margin-top:24px;color:#9fb0c6">PLAN WISELY. • GROW STEADILY. • LIVE FREELY.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="hero-card">
      <img class="portrait" src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Raymond John Bonus, Financial Advisor">
      <div class="hero-badge"><b>Raymond John Bonus</b><span>Financial Advisor • Brilliant Quartz II</span></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="section" id="planning">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="section-head">
      <div class="kicker">Financial Planning</div>
      <h2>Your money should have a purpose.</h2>
      <p>Good planning starts with understanding what matters most to you, then building a strategy around those priorities.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="cards">
      <article class="card"><div class="icon">01</div><h3>Financial Protection</h3><p>Prepare for uncertainties and help protect the people, income, and goals that matter most.</p></article>
      <article class="card"><div class="icon">02</div><h3>Wealth Building</h3><p>Turn long-term goals into a practical roadmap for growing and managing your financial resources.</p></article>
      <article class="card"><div class="icon">03</div><h3>Legacy Planning</h3><p>Think beyond today and prepare intentionally for the people and causes you want to support.</p></article>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="section alt" id="about">
  <div class="container about">
    <div class="about-box">
      <div class="quote">“The goal isn't simply to have more. It's to have a plan for what matters.”</div>
      <div style="color:#c9d5e3">Raymond John Bonus<br><strong style="color:#fff">Financial Advisor</strong></div>
    </div>
    <div class="about-copy">
      <div class="kicker">About Raymond</div>
      <h2>Advice that starts with listening.</h2>
      <p>Every financial situation is different. A meaningful planning conversation begins by understanding your current position, your responsibilities, and the goals you want to pursue.</p>
      <p>Raymond's role is to help clients organize those priorities, explore appropriate financial strategies, and make informed decisions with greater clarity.</p>
      <p><strong style="color:var(--navy)">No one-size-fits-all promises. Just a thoughtful process built around your goals.</strong></p>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="section" id="approach">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="section-head">
      <div class="kicker">The Process</div>
      <h2>A clearer path starts here.</h2>
      <p>Financial planning doesn't need to feel overwhelming. We can break it down into manageable conversations.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="steps">
      <div class="step"><strong>01</strong><h3>Understand</h3><p>Clarify your goals and priorities.</p></div>
      <div class="step"><strong>02</strong><h3>Review</h3><p>Look at your current financial picture.</p></div>
      <div class="step"><strong>03</strong><h3>Prioritize</h3><p>Identify what deserves attention first.</p></div>
      <div class="step"><strong>04</strong><h3>Plan</h3><p>Explore strategies suited to your needs.</p></div>
      <div class="step"><strong>05</strong><h3>Review</h3><p>Adjust your plan as life changes.</p></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="section alt" id="career">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="recruit">
      <div>
        <div class="kicker">Career Opportunity</div>
        <h2>Build a career with purpose.</h2>
        <p>Brilliant Quartz II is also growing a community of people who want to develop professionally while helping families make better-informed financial decisions.</p>
        <div class="pills"><span class="pill">Training & Mentorship</span><span class="pill">Professional Growth</span><span class="pill">Flexible Career Path</span><span class="pill">Purpose-Driven Work</span></div>
        <a class="btn btn-gold" href="#contact">Explore the Opportunity</a>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align:center">
        <div style="font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:74px;color:var(--gold2)">∞</div>
        <p style="font-size:20px"><strong>Your potential is bigger than one job title.</strong></p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="section" id="contact">
  <div class="container contact">
    <div class="contact-panel">
      <div class="kicker">Let's Connect</div>
      <h3>Start with a conversation.</h3>
      <p>Whether you're exploring financial planning or a career in financial advising, let's talk about where you want to go.</p>
      <div class="contact-line"><strong>Raymond John Bonus</strong><br>Financial Advisor • Brilliant Quartz II</div>
      <div class="contact-line">Email: <span style="color:#f4d37b">YOUR-EMAIL@EXAMPLE.COM</span></div>
      <div class="contact-line">Phone: <span style="color:#f4d37b">YOUR PHONE NUMBER</span></div>
      <div class="contact-line">Facebook / Instagram / LinkedIn: <span style="color:#f4d37b">Add your links</span></div>
    </div>
    <form class="form" onsubmit="event.preventDefault(); alert('Thank you! Please connect this form to your preferred email/form service before publishing.');">
      <h3 style="font-family:Georgia,serif;color:var(--navy);font-size:28px;margin-bottom:18px">Send an inquiry</h3>
      <label for="name">Name</label><input id="name" required placeholder="Your name">
      <label for="email">Email</label><input id="email" type="email" required placeholder="you@example.com">
      <label for="interest">I'm interested in</label><input id="interest" placeholder="Financial planning or career opportunity">
      <label for="message">Message</label><textarea id="message" required placeholder="Tell Raymond what you'd like to discuss."></textarea>
      <button class="btn btn-gold" type="submit" style="border:0;cursor:pointer;width:100%">Send Message</button>
    </form>
  </div>
</section>
</main>

<footer class="footer">
  <div class="container footer-inner">
    <div><strong style="color:#fff;font-family:Georgia,serif">Brilliant Quartz II</strong><br><small>PLAN WISELY. • GROW STEADILY. • LIVE FREELY.</small></div>
    <small>© 2026 Brilliant Quartz II. All rights reserved.</small>
  </div>

</footer>
